name: @absolutejs/meeting-recall
description: Recall.ai source adapter for @absolutejs/meeting — Recall joins a Google Meet / Zoom / Teams call as a bot and streams per-participant audio into the meeting core for live transcription + analysis
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/manifest.ts --outdir dist --root src --target bun --external @absolutejs/manifest --external '@absolutejs/manifest/*' --external @absolutejs/meeting --external '@absolutejs/meeting/*' --external @absolutejs/voice --external '@absolutejs/voice/*' --external @sinclair/typebox --external '@sinclair/typebox/*' && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json && absolute-manifest emit
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public --tag beta
scripts.check:package: bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run verify-package && bun run build && bun run verify-package --artifacts
